title: Cross-Model Feature Universality for a Single Safety Concept

original_idea.body:
# Cross-Model Feature Universality for a Single Safety Concept

**Problem:** Unknown whether a safety feature (refusal) occupies a comparable role across open model families. Universality means monitoring transfers.

**Direction:** Locate one safety concept in three open families via probe/SAE and test analogous causal role via representational-similarity. Report a universality score.

**Why it matters:** Determines portability of interpretability-based safety findings. Pure inference.

**Relevant context:** Olah et al.; Gemma-2/Llama-3/Qwen3; TransformerLens.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain (portability of monitoring tools) but indirect catastrophic-risk link.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Probe/RSA across three open families, no training; guided though multi-model.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused on one concept across three models with a universality-score deliverable.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Pure inference on public weights, portability question labs won't prioritize.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference across three open models; single mid GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Universality is a recurring theme; a single-safety-concept cross-family causal test may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Universality is studied broadly; this safety-concept-specific causal test may be open.
